svg.title: dsh-github structure: a grade-separated checkpoint
svg.desc: Seven read tools ride an overpass labelled next() over one approval gate. Eight write tools stop at tools/pre-execute, allowedActions and ctx.approval, then both tracks merge into api.github.com. The /review background job and the CI status-check gate feed back into the same gate.
svg.text: writes ask a human · reads call next() · one token per operation
deny → structured error · no API call
tokenSource: auto · allowedActions whitelist · 429 backoff · fail-closed
